title: Vision Detection Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Vision_Detection_Generator.md
text: Detect objects and lanes from visual measurements in a driving scenario or RoadRunner Scenario, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Width of actors cuboids (m)} sets Width of cuboid; {Unique identifier of sensor} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Types of detections generated by sensor} selects the types of detections Objects, {Required interval between sensor updates (s)} sets the required time interval, {Required interval between lane detections updates (s)} sets the time interval between lane detection, {Sensor’s (x,y) position (m)} sets the location of the vision sensor center, {Sensor’s height (m)} sets the vision sensor height above the ground, {Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Source of object bus name}, {Source of output lane bus name} sets the source of lane bus name, {Object bus name} sets the name of object bus valid, {Specify an output lane bus name} sets the name of output lane bus valid, {Maximum number of reported detections}, {Maximum number of reported lanes}, {Coordinate system used to report detections} sets the coordinate system of reported detections Ego, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Maximum detection range (m)}, {Bounding box accuracy (pixels)}, {Smoothing filter noise intensity (m/s^2)} sets the noise intensity used for filtering position and velocity, {Maximum detectable object speed (m/s)}, {Maximum allowed occlusion for detector}, {Minimum detectable image size of an object} sets the minimum height and width of an object, {Probability of detecting a target} sets the probability of detection, {Number of false positives per image} sets the number of false detections generated by vision sensor per, {Minimum lane size in image (pixels)} sets the maximum size of lane, {Accuracy of lane boundary (pixels)}, {Add noise to measurements} enables adding noise to vision sensor, {Select method to specify initial seed} sets the method to specify random number generator seed, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator seed, {Select method to specify actor profiles} sets the method to specify actor profiles From Scenario Reader, {MATLAB expression for actor profiles}, {Unique identifier for actors} sets the scenario-defined actor identifier, {User-defined integer to classify actors} sets the user-defined classification identifier, {Length of actors cuboids (m)} sets the length of cuboid, {Height of actors cuboids (m)} sets the height of cuboid, {Rotational center of actors from bottom center (m)} sets the rotational center of the actor, {Focal length (pixels)} sets the camera focal length, {Optical center of the camera (pixels)} sets the optical center of camera, {Image size produced by the camera (pixels)} sets the image size produced by camera, {Radial distortion coefficients}, {Tangential distortion coefficients} and {Skew of the camera axes} sets the skew angle of camera axes. Values come from the instance.
